data.body: Gerrit 3386 merged as 9da38e2a526 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved), submitted 17:14 PST. Live External Integration dispatched on that SHA: run 43343447995. Plan re-review PASS, certified. Its advisory found a real gap in the merged workflow step: the failure/cancel cleanup deleted every JQL summary~ hit, and JQL text search is fuzzy, so in shared REB it could delete an unrelated issue (the Python backstop already re-checks the exact prefix). Follow-up commit 8fa210ad340 makes the step delete only hits whose summary contains the run prefix verbatim, with a test pinning it; exercised for real with a non-matching prefix and against a fuzzy/exact sample. make verify running.
